artifact_policy: Charge full-model/encoder/decoder/diffusion tensor safetensors, learned quantile transform arrays, latent-derived mean, projection and model manifest; no unsafe object serialization, no training rows/latent row matrix needed at sample replay.
checkpoint_policy: Preserve categorical-only validation objective (numeric weight zero), scheduler/beta rules, final-epoch encoder/decoder export and diffusion best-training-loss checkpoint; numeric empty CE defined as zero.
fit_adaptations: Empty categorical CE/accuracy set to zero; numeric MSE/KL unchanged.
No categorical token is passed for the numeric-only joint representation.
Author categorical-only validation objective remains zero for numeric inputs; first full-model checkpoint, final encoder/decoder export preserved.
DataLoader num_workers=0 to preserve isolated worker/no subprocess contract; batch/shuffle rules retained.
Direct author sampler receives explicit rows/device and50steps, bypassing the fixed-row author CLI.
Safe tensor weights and numeric quantile/latent-mean state replace pickle/full latent rows; exact seeded generated replay required.
fit_failure_policy: Whole-fit timeout or VRAM excess => visible charged partial failure, no checkpoint sample or native-selection eligibility.
generator_grid_provenance: Campaign-defined two-value max_beta grid, author-exposed CLI parameter; no upstream generator grid exists in audited source; not an author-search reproduction.

native_objective.real_partition_for_future_tuning: only frozen official-training-derived validation, staged under the author test-named path
native_objective.selection_behavior: select auditor parameters by internal synthetic validation R2, then refit and measure on real evaluation partition
native_objective.target_transform: log(clip(y, 1, 20000)) for auditor fit labels and real evaluation labels; internal synthetic validation labels remain untransformed

tuning_seed_policy.cpu_threads: Author nthread=-1 retained; bounded by assigned sixteen-core CPU affinity.

native_partition: Only frozen official-training-derived validation; author test-named path contains validation, never official test.
source_scope: Numeric-only regression compatibility contract for the S3 projected panel; no full mixed-type contract admitted.
target_information_policy: Require finite nonconstant log(clip(validation target,1,20000)); uninformative native targets retain default with tuning-inapplicable receipt; no native winner.
